# About Wedding India Expo

Wedding India Expo is India's First International Destination Wedding Exhibition.

The exhibition connects the complete wedding ecosystem including destination wedding planners, luxury hotels, resorts, tourism boards, wedding venues, decorators, florists, bridal fashion brands, jewellery companies, photographers, videographers, entertainment providers, caterers, technology companies, invitation designers, gifting companies, honeymoon specialists, event management companies, and wedding suppliers.

The objective is to position India as one of the world's leading destination wedding countries while creating business opportunities for domestic and international wedding companies.

The exhibition serves as a B2B and B2C networking platform where brands meet wedding planners, destination wedding buyers, hospitality companies, travel professionals, luxury venues, influencers, media, and consumers.

Wedding India Expo Ecosystem

Wedding India Expo is India's First International Destination Wedding Exhibition and Business Platform.

The exhibition connects the complete global wedding ecosystem through exhibitions, conferences, destination showcases, hosted buyer programmes, networking events, business matchmaking, product launches, hospitality experiences, and international collaborations.

Wedding India Expo serves as a B2B and B2C marketplace for companies involved in weddings, tourism, hospitality, luxury lifestyle, events, fashion, jewellery, food, technology, travel, finance, media, and destination marketing.

Wedding Food India Expo

Wedding Food India Expo is a co-located exhibition within Wedding India Expo.

It focuses on wedding catering, hospitality, hotels, resorts, banquet venues, chefs, food brands, dessert companies, beverage brands, bakery companies, cloud kitchens, luxury dining experiences, and destination wedding cuisine.

The objective is to help hotels, caterers, and hospitality companies generate new business through food experiences and destination wedding solutions.

Visitors can:

Taste regional and international cuisines
Compare wedding menus
Meet executive chefs
Book catering companies
Explore luxury hospitality
Discover destination dining experiences
Connect with banquet operators
Meet hotel wedding specialists
